content.caption:
Your bladder actually depends on more than just water intake — cranberries contain compounds that make it harder for bacteria to cling to the bladder wall, which is why they're linked to fewer infections. Your spleen, an organ almost nobody talks about, filters old blood cells and relies on iron-rich foods like beets to keep producing fresh ones efficiently. And your thyroid needs iodine to make its hormones at all — seaweed is one of the few natural foods concentrated enough to meaningfully support that process. Of course, everyone's body is different, so listen to yours and talk to a doctor about your specific needs.

At @smarthealthfix, we break down nutrition, common symptoms, organ function, and small daily habits so you actually understand your body instead of just guessing. Our mission is to help you build small, realistic habits instead of chasing quick fixes.
